Provisional strand focus: Database vocabulary, records/fields/types; inspect a supplied relational fixture
Practice before assessment: Distinguish a raw record from a useful report. Use a supplied fixture before expecting students to create a schema.

Provisional strand focus: PK/FK relationships and first SELECT projection
Practice before assessment: Select named fields from one table. Read the relationship before using it later; distinguish projection from deletion.

Provisional strand focus: WHERE comparisons, literal types and ORDER BY
Practice before assessment: Predict and execute a filter/order on fresh rows; show target and excluded rows.

Provisional strand focus: AND/OR/NOT, parentheses and LIKE; simple INNER JOIN through known keys
Practice before assessment: Compare grouped conditions; manually match parent/child keys before a simple joined report. No multi-table Year 12 complexity.

Provisional strand focus: Consolidate the taught query operations without adding an unseen test demand
Practice before assessment: A changed filter/join task uses known tables; feedback names the first wrong condition/key.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 1 cybersecurity theory test; 1 feedback; 1 SQL retrieval; 1 scheduled security/control work

Provisional strand focus: COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX over the correct records
Practice before assessment: Predict aggregate outputs from a small fixture before running them. Complex GROUP BY/HAVING remains Year 12 scope; any optional grouping example is labelled.

Provisional strand focus: Dependencies, anomalies and UNF→1NF→2NF; draft design before CREATE
Practice before assessment: Explain the dependency removed at each stage and retain a meaningful relationship. Prepare a proposed project design without pretending this is independently authored final work.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 2 modelling; 1 SQL retrieval; 1 formative project preparation

Provisional strand focus: 3NF and schema creation; constraints; INSERT parent/child records
Practice before assessment: Independently create a fresh small database, enable actual FK enforcement and test duplicate/orphan/required-value failures.

Provisional strand focus: UPDATE/DELETE with exact WHERE targets; integrate queries and schema skills
Practice before assessment: Run a changed mock practical and corrective feedback before Week 10. Scope includes only what has already been explicitly taught and practised.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 2 formal project workshops; 1 safe changes; 1 mock/check and feedback

Provisional strand focus: SQL practical, then diagnosis; no first teaching of assessed syntax here
Practice before assessment: 50-minute practical +5 minutes administration. Target list: SELECT, WHERE/Boolean/LIKE, ORDER BY, simple INNER JOIN, aggregates, taught CREATE/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/constraints. Drop any item without prior independent practice evidence.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 1 controlled practical; 1 post-collection feedback; 2 project workshops

Provisional strand focus: Parameterised application calls for the chosen driver; apply taught database work
Practice before assessment: Separate SQL syntax from bound data; the chosen driver determines placeholders. This is after the practical and is not retroactively added to its scope.

Provisional strand focus: Project testing and safe backup/restore verification
Practice before assessment: Open a restored separate copy and query known records. Additional transaction depth/server administration is an extension unless explicitly taught for the local project.

Provisional strand focus: Finish project demonstration, evidence and evaluation
Practice before assessment: Judge against issued criteria using actual query/change/recovery evidence. No new compulsory framework/driver/syntax at the deadline.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 4 project slots including demonstration, evaluation and feedback

Provisional strand focus: Mixed retrieval and recovery reasoning; optional server extensions separated
Practice before assessment: Use changed records/design/security facts to check retained skills. Optional server log replay is not a prerequisite for the default project.

Provisional strand focus: Unfamiliar SQL/ERD/normalisation/security exam practice
Practice before assessment: Practice with supplied stimulus, preserve original responses, explain corrections and retry changed cases.

Provisional strand focus: Formal examination; no essential new SQL teaching
Practice before assessment: Textbook is preparation/review only during a closed-book examination. Arrange a continuous school-approved session and separate later feedback.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: Exam/preparation/administration according to the actual school timetable

Provisional strand focus: Diagnose Year 11 keys/SELECT/filter/order/basic joins; repair before extension
Practice before assessment: Fresh diagnostic names prerequisite gaps. Use prepared fixtures so server/DDL setup does not block query learning.

Provisional strand focus: INNER JOIN chains up to four tables, aliases and qualified names
Practice before assessment: Predict one row per declared report entity and inspect every ON key. Repair missing join conditions without hiding the problem with DISTINCT.

Provisional strand focus: Aggregate at the correct grain; GROUP BY; support-booklet HAVING
Practice before assessment: Calculate small expected groups manually; distinguish selected attributes, row filters and group filters.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 2 SQL; 1 web-security concepts; 1 grouped report practice

Provisional strand focus: WHERE versus support-booklet HAVING group filtering; calculated/concatenated fields; NULL semantics
Practice before assessment: Use nonzero capacities for percentages, defined NULL meaning and composite-key matches; explain deterministic ordering.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 2 SQL; 1 secure coding; 1 independent changed report

Provisional strand focus: LEFT JOIN and zero-count reports; filter placement
Practice before assessment: Predict an unbooked parent row and compare COUNT(*) with COUNT(non-null child key). Do not conflate a missing record with recorded absence.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 1 security theory test; 1 feedback; 1 SQL model; 1 independent SQL check

Provisional strand focus: Review CREATE/ALTER/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/constraints, then transactions
Practice before assessment: Positive and failed second-step cases demonstrate actual commit/rollback and unchanged non-target rows. Constraints and authorisation are separate.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 2 SQL/transaction lessons; 1 ethics/privacy; 1 independent transaction check

Provisional strand focus: 3NF, wider ER interpretation and project-sized dictionary/schema reconciliation
Practice before assessment: Trace PK/FK/optionality and dependencies; design at the required scale. BCNF/additional server topics are extensions, not hidden replacements for core modelling.

Provisional strand focus: Python/DBMS connectivity, bound parameters and transaction tests
Practice before assessment: Use the selected driver, trace application/request/result and run a changed mock practical with feedback. sqlite3 is not an ODBC driver.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 1 connectivity; 1 parameterised operations; 1 mock; 1 correction/independent retry

Provisional strand focus: Launch the database project; integrate already-taught report and change operations
Practice before assessment: Consolidate a changed dataset before the practical. Read all required operations against the teaching record; no surprise extension item.

Provisional strand focus: Controlled SQL practical then specific post-collection repair
Practice before assessment: 50-minute practical +5 minutes administration. Candidate scope is taught joins/grouping/HAVING/calculations/NULL/LEFT JOIN/schema changes/transactions; include bound application calls only where independently practised and feasible under the adopted conditions.

Provisional strand focus: Project data quality, import and application integration
Practice before assessment: Preserve raw source, record cleaning decisions and demonstrate an agreed all-or-none failure policy. New import teaching is not claimed as prior Week 10 knowledge.

Provisional strand focus: Restore/reopen, regression testing and recovery limitations
Practice before assessment: Verify an actual persisted copy and query known contents; distinguish in-memory rollback from durable recovery. Server replay/replication are separate optional cases.

Provisional strand focus: Finish demonstration/evaluation/handover with no new required dependency
Practice before assessment: Explain independently one report, one rejected operation and one recovery result using the issued scope. Record incomplete criteria honestly.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: 4 project slots including demonstration, evaluation and feedback

Provisional strand focus: Mixed short-answer database/security/programming/network retrieval
Practice before assessment: Use source facts, command verbs and manual SQL predictions; corrected work remains separate from original timed responses.

Provisional strand focus: Extended scenario transfer and delayed retries
Practice before assessment: Integrate ERDs/3NF/report reasoning and algorithm/security explanations. Dedicated search/sort/Big O teaching must remain in Unit 3, not first appear as revision here.

Provisional strand focus: Formal examination; no essential new SQL teaching
Practice before assessment: Preparation/review references only; no mid-paper book use unless allowed. Confirm a continuous school exam session separately.
Allocation inside four ordinary slots: Exam/preparation/administration according to the actual school timetable
